result.summary: This residential street environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While the narrow street width and stop-controlled intersection may naturally limit vehicle speeds, the presence of parked cars near the corners creates significant sightline obstructions for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions creates a physical barrier for individuals with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: All visible corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the intersection corners block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street approaching the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection and install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to improve sightlines and shorten crossing distances.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. While the low-density residential setting suggests lower traffic volumes, the wide, unmarked roadway and lack of designated crossing points create risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Absence of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle speed or right-of-way at the junction.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area

hazards.name: Sidewalk overgrowth
hazards.description: Vegetation is encroaching on the sidewalk on the left side of the image, narrowing the usable path.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides but lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. Parked vehicles along the curbs create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.
